title: Delegation worktree sweep: settle only on definitive evidence and clear the settled mark when a follow-up starts a new attempt
outcome: A delegation worktree that the sweep skipped for a transient reason, or whose delegation got a follow-up, is inspected again after its next end instead of waiting for a restart.
acceptance: The sweep marks a delegation settled only on definitive evidence (no .git file, or a readable owner naming another delegation); a Git or IO failure during inspection waits for a later pass instead.
A follow-up that starts a new attempt removes the delegation from the settled set, so its worktree is reclaimed after that attempt ends when it has nothing to lose.
Behavioural tests cover both: a transient inspection failure followed by a successful pass, and a follow-up after a settled skip.
